example.title: Church Street, South of Broad, Charleston, SC (49550285387)

brief: A Charleston single house: Church Street, South of Broad, Charleston, SC (49550285387), one room wide with its gable end to the street and tiered side piazzas; see the photo for its piazzas, trim and colour. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Charleston single house (one room wide, side piazzas, gable end to the street) is an 18th-19th-century type; newer examples are used first where they exist. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
